subject: Telemetry add-ons: quantified savings, roll-up credits, and bundling questions
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <contracts@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question: telemetry add-ons — retention vs advanced dashboards

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re trying to finalize our internal cost model for the next quarter and have a few concrete questions about the observability add-ons: retention (hot/warm storage for traces & spans), tracing as a metered ingest, and the advanced dashboards package (seat-based + visualization credits).

A couple of specific asks so we can push a vendor recommendation to procurement:
- Can you provide a simple example that shows dollar impact for 1M trace events/month with 30-day vs 90-day retention?
- Do credits for dashboard queries roll over month-to-month if unused?
- If we take a 12-month billing commitment, what is the largest discount you can give on the observability bundle (retention+tracing+dashboards)? We’re likely in the $100k–$250k ARR band if we move forward with Redwood as the inference layer.

Also looping in Legal (contracts@acme.com) because there will be standard timelines and IP questions. Can you send an updated SKU/quote we can attach to the purchase request?

Samir
VP, Platform Engineering
Acme Payments

P.S. Attachments: none on this message.
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question: telemetry add-ons — retention vs advanced dashboards

Hi Samir — great to hear you’re moving the recommendation forward. I pulled together a brief SKU and three packaging options; PDF attached (redwood-observability-sku-v2.pdf). High level answers first:

- Example economics (1M trace events/month):
  - 30-day retention (default hot): ~$1,200/mo for storage + $900/mo ingest/meters = ~$2,100/mo
  - 90-day retention (hot+warm): ~$2,900/mo (additional warm storage and archive retrievals)
  These are illustrative — final numbers depend on average span size and sampling rate.

- Dashboard credits: credits do not expire immediately and can roll for up to two billing cycles for pilot customers; we can include a roll-over clause in the SOW for an initial 12-month purchase.

- Discounting for a 12-month commit: standard is 20% on observability add-ons for a full-year pre-pay at the $150k+ ARR threshold. I put together an accelerated concession proposal below (requesting internal approval):
  - Option A (standard): 20% bundle discount for 12-month prepay; includes 30-day retention baseline and 5 dashboard seats.
  - Option B (pilot concession): 30% off observability add-ons for the first 6 months, then revert to 15% off for the remainder of the year — requirement: $150k committed total Redwood spend.
  - Option C (metered): No prepay; 12% recurring discount for 12 months, dashboard credits capped monthly.

Next steps I recommend: 30-minute call this week to walk the SKU and tune sampling assumptions, then I’ll produce a formal quote and SOW with the roll-over language for Legal. When would Samir be available? I can send a short calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood-observability-sku-v2.pdf (1 file)

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <contracts@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question: telemetry add-ons — retention vs advanced dashboards

Michael — thanks for the fast turnaround and the SKU. A few follow-ups after skimming the PDF:

- The 30% pilot concession (Option B) sounds promising, but our procurement lead needs clear guardrails: we’d like the concession documented as a timebound credit that appears on the invoice, not an oral promise. Can you confirm Redwood will include that language in the SOW and that it will survive renewal conversation?
- For rollover credits: two billing cycles is workable for the pilot, but can you confirm whether dashboard query credits are first-in, first-out when applied to overages? We want deterministic billing.
- Final ask on discounting: if we commit $150k ARR to Redwood, can we get the 30% concession plus an additional 5% platform usage credit (applied to inference API usage), or is that outside typical redlines?

Legal also wants a draft SOW / payment timeline so they can align on PO lead times. I can take a 30-minute slot tomorrow afternoon (Fri 24th) or Monday morning if that works for you.

Thanks,
Samir

Subject: Fwd: Packaging question: telemetry add-ons — retention vs advanced dashboards (approval requested)

Hi Kim / Karthik — forwarding below. Acme (Samir) is asking for the 30% pilot concession (Option B) plus an ask for an additional 5% platform usage credit if they commit $150k ARR. They want the concession documented in the SOW as an invoice line item and timebound.

Why I’m flagging: Acme is a strategic vertical logo (payments) with good chance to expand across product lines; losing them would likely push procurement to a competitor. The ask is a one-time margin hit on observability add-ons but buys us a stronger platform expansion path.

Proposal: approve Option B with an explicit SOW clause: 30% concession applied to observability add-on invoice lines for months 1–6, followed by 15% for months 7–12. As a stretch, approve an additional 3% platform usage credit (instead of 5%), applied to inference API charges as a one-time true-up on the first invoice. This preserves margin while giving Procurement a tangible win.

If you’re ok, I’ll draft the SOW text and run it by Legal. If you’d prefer a separate finance sign-off, tell me who to loop.

Thanks,
Michael
